summary_bullets: Emit BOTH_DOWN from the degraded-tools gate when both Codex and Cursor are unavailable
Auto-proceed with a notice when exactly one external tool is down; prompt only when both are down
Document the BOTH_DOWN branch in external-reviewers.md and all four Step 0 skill callers
commit_message:
Degraded-tools gate: auto-proceed when one tool is down (#3291)

Add BOTH_DOWN to degraded-tools-gate.sh so interactive skills warn and proceed when exactly one of Codex or Cursor is unavailable, and only AskUserQuestion when both are down. Update external-reviewers.md and design/implement/research/review Step 0 prose with exact-string BOTH_DOWN=false checks.
